title: A space kid calls the Nine a sandbox

tellings.quote: the nine was basically just like this sandbox for us to to to play in or something.

plain: In the 1970s, in Ossining, New York, one of the "space kids", children said to have psychic contact with otherworldly beings, is said to have described "the Nine", a council of non-human intelligences that some people claimed to receive messages from, as "basically just like this sandbox for us to play in." The researcher Greg Malatzi passes this on to Michels from an unnamed space kid. It would mean that, to those children, the famous alien council was less a ruling body than a kind of playground.
